why: Argo v3 is built route by route as the sibling app on the same API; the usage route is 60 files, so its quota, over-time and drain parts land first. Gated by the G4 freeze.
what: The usage tracking quotas, quota chart, over time, drain, heat, pace, period, rhythm, weekly volume and verdict band with their models and tests. No route file.
must_not_touch: apps/dashboard/**, apps/api/**, packages/shared/**, .basalt/**, apps/dashboard-v3/package.json and bun.lock (v3-argo-bump-g3/g4), other Issues' dirs under apps/dashboard-v3/src
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.1-6.3, argo DESIGN.md and the managed layer (.claude/rules/basalt-v3-*.md, skills basalt-v3-*). basalt-ui is pinned exact next.N (the gate's floor, v3-argo-bump in `after`): its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth; never edit package.json or bun.lock. Never import apps/dashboard; share through @argo/shared. *.module.css files are not ported (classes replace them). This feature's model.ts, types.ts and tests are ported here.
exemplar: Follow apps/dashboard-v3/src/routes/__root.tsx, then the nearest landed route port, and the catalogue in .claude/skills/basalt-v3-design.
change: Port the quota cards and quota-chart, over-time, drain-chart with drain-model, heat-model, pace-model, period-model, rhythm, weekly-volume and verdict-band on chart kinds, ChartCard facts and ui/meter; models and their tests unchanged apart from imports. Categorical colour follows ledger rows 232-233 (sibling series are not one hue family; adjacent ramp steps are not distinct in dark mode). Rule: the app preset passes without new waivers. Skill snippet: none; recipes: the installed docs/recipes.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: Unit and DOM tests only; the rendered proof is the parent route Issue's board.
acceptance: `make check` exits 0 (runs check-v3: sync --check, doctor, lint, typecheck, build, test)

`bun scripts/check-test-port.ts apps/dashboard/src/features/usage-tracking apps/dashboard-v3/src/features/usage-tracking --only '{quotas,quota-chart,over-time,drain,heat,pace,period,rhythm,weekly-volume,verdict-band}*'` exits 0 and `bun --cwd apps/dashboard-v3 test src/features/usage-tracking` passes (changed lines carry `// port: <reason>` markers, listed in the PR)

a test over the series each chart draws in dark mode asserts every pair in one chart is at least 0.10 apart in OKLab distance (the owner-rejected pair #38bdf8 and #7dd3fc measures 0.083; ledger rows 232-233)
each chart renders through renderApp at loading, ready and empty without throwing
